item.title: Army awards lease of Pine Bluff Arsenal to Hanwha Defense USA for planned $1.3 billion investment, lawmakers react
item.description: Federal lawmakers from Arkansas have shared statements supporting the move by the U.S. Army to lease out the Pine Bluff Arsenal.

item.title: Bishop of Diocese of Little Rock makes public statements comparing current times to 1930s Germany
item.description: Bishop Anthony Basil Taylor of the Diocese of Little Rock has made a public statement comparing the current American experience to 1930s Germany, citing the dehumanizing of "other" groups and the dangers of excessive nationalism and false representations of history.

item.title: Central Arkansas plumber discusses increase in calls this time of year due to busted pipes
item.description: Rick Johnson said it’s the busiest time of year for a plumber. Averaging about 30 calls per day, he said when the ice begins to thaw under the sun, so can the frozen water in your pipes.

item.title: Saline County Fairgrounds rodeo arena collapses under heavy snow
item.description: The roof of the main rodeo arena at the Saline County Fairgrounds collapsed Tuesday afternoon under the weight of heavy, dense snow, leaving the structure a total loss and forcing the cancellation and relocation of numerous upcoming events.

item.title: Arkansas state offices to remain closed on Thursday
item.description: The lingering impact of winter weather has shut down Arkansas state offices for a fourth consecutive day.

item.title: Owners of Benton business describe downtown building collapse
item.description: A portion of a downtown Benton building collapsed Tuesday afternoon, triggering a multi-agency emergency response and a search of nearby businesses. Officials say no injuries were reported.

item.title: Arkansans beginning to get cabin fever with some roads still in rough condition
item.description: While many main roads are beginning to get back to normal, side roads and roads in residential neighborhoods are not. Leading to some Arkansans beginning to get stir crazy.

item.title: Wednesday's Child: Meet Charles and Caylee, twins hoping for a forever family who will care for them
item.description: 16-year-old twins, Charles and Caylee know the ups and downs of being in foster care all too well. The sibling duo lives apart right now, but they want to start a new chapter of their life together, with one forever family.

item.title: Downtown Benton building collapses, multiple others damaged
item.description: A building collapsed in downtown Benton on Wednesday afternoon, damaging multiple others in the process.
